annotations.title: Battery loss factors (MLF) by financial year

description: Transmission loss factors (MLF) for one battery by financial year from FY2024-25: mlf_discharge (credits each MWh discharged), mlf_charge (bills each MWh charged), mlf_spread, and gross energy revenue at MLF 1.0 versus at the unit's loss factors (energy_rev_gross, energy_rev_mlf, mlf_effect, split into discharge_effect and charge_effect). The comparison holds dispatch fixed, so it is illustrative: a different loss factor would have changed how the unit bid. A charge factor below 1 lowers charging cost, so mlf_effect can be positive. source says whether the factor came from AEMO's published MLF list or DUDETAILSUMMARY.
